'''Ungo''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Ungo the Hutt" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Ungo was looking to hire security to escort a shipment of theirs through the [[Kellis system/Legends|Kellis system]], which was full of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
An individual affiliated with one of the two sides in the Cold War then sent a companion of theirs to escort the shipment. The companion was able to fend off a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attack, and Ungo gratefully offered them a generous reward.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ungo was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Ungo the Hutt" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
